title: Street Name History
description: *Street Name History* is a **web tool** that takes any street you search and shows **every name it carries across languages**, the **former names** it has shed over time, and **who or what it was named after** — pulling the answer together live in the browser.

I directed the concept and the **multi-source data architecture**: geocoding and multilingual/historical name tags from **OpenStreetMap** (Nominatim), etymology from **Wikidata**, and dated name timelines from **OpenHistoricalMap**, with enrichment layered on non-blocking so the core result always renders. The pure logic is **TDD-covered** with Bun.

The result is a keyless, serverless tool that runs on static hosting and degrades gracefully: it surfaces whatever mappers have contributed and says plainly when a street's history simply isn't recorded yet.
